name: fileit
description: Decentralized, cross-device file sharing, interactive PDF studio, WebRTC data beam, and 3-day self-dissolving rooms.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && mkdir -p dist/server && (cp -rf artifacts/fileit/dist/public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -rf artifacts/api-server/dist/* dist/server/ 2>/dev/null || true)
